provenance: every value below is produced by executing the Stage-5 model

replay_purity_S5B_2.scenario: predecessor [0,80) then successor [40,100) on one lineage

A_honest_baseline_disabled.description: All Stage-5 features DISABLED: the frozen Stage-4C behaviour, unchanged.

B_ownership_predecessor_and_successor.description: S5B-1 END TO END: an undetected progress-withholding claim creates a successor that re-evaluates below the accepted frontier; the predecessor keeps its own work and the successor is paid only for the unique suffix it adds.

C_true_path_b_reserve_reassignment.description: S5B-3: a GENUINE Path-B reserve reassignment (needs_stage3_wake, an AVAILABLE reserve, a ReserveActivationRequest) that applies accepted-frontier separation; the physical frontier still never rewinds.

D_reserve_and_path_b_delayed_wakes.description: S5B-4: DELAYED_WAKE on every miner with the floor engaged and a fault — the initial primary wake, the ordinary reserve-activation wake and the Path-B reassignment reserve wake all consult the delayed-wake policy.

E_path_a_delayed_wake.description: S5B-4: a LATE fault whose reassignee is an already-alive miner that exhausted its own range — the Path-A reassignment wake consults the same policy.

F_delayed_wake_another_reserve_activated.description: S5B-4: a delayed wake that keeps active capacity below the operational floor really causes ANOTHER reserve activation inside the added interval.

G_delayed_wake_cancelled_at_close.description: S5B-4: a wake still pending at round closure is charged over the REALISED added interval, never over the configured extra latency.

H_zero_action_budget.description: S5B-5: maximum_actions_per_round = 0 prevents EVERY action type; each refusal is counted and creates no protocol effect.

I_free_rider_and_assignment_splitter.description: S5B-6: FREE_RIDER 0.5 combined with ASSIGNMENT_SPLITTER x4 budgets the EFFECTIVE 50 nonces/s across four subassignments, never the nominal 100.

J_misreporter_and_assignment_splitter.description: S5B-6: HASH_RATE_MISREPORTER x5 combined with ASSIGNMENT_SPLITTER x4 — over-reporting buys no physical capacity at all.

K_multiple_controlled_miners_and_identit.description: S5B-6: two controlled miners, each split, plus four declared virtual identities — the entity's physical capacity is unchanged.

L_executed_abandonment_coverage_gap.description: S5B-7: an executed abandonment records its REAL unsearched suffix; the round closes with the explicit adversarial coverage-gap disposition and can never be labelled ordinary or full-domain exhaustion.

M_false_claim_offset_overstatement.description: S5B-7/8: a configured false-exhaustion offset separates the claim overstatement from the REAL unsearched suffix, and the offset is honoured rather than silently overridden by range-end claiming.

N_physical_count_without_range_leases.description: S5B-8: the physical evaluation count reconciles with the evaluation ledger when range leases are DISABLED.

O_physical_count_with_range_leases.description: S5B-8: ... and when range leases are ENABLED.

P_floor_and_reported_rate_allocation.description: S5B-8: the operational security floor and reported-rate allocation EXECUTE TOGETHER — the reserve domain keeps its slices and only the primary span is re-sized from reported rates.

scope.fixed_target: No Stage-5 parameter changes the fixed SHA-256 target or difficulty; dynamic difficulty remains excluded.
scope.nonce_partitioning: Nonce-domain partitioning alone is NOT an energy-saving mechanism and is never described as one.
scope.what_this_is: Deterministic micro-scenario MEASUREMENTS of bounded modeled adversarial behaviours running on the accepted Stage-4C PoCol core.
scope.what_this_is_not: NOT the confirmatory experiment matrix, NOT a statistical result, and NOT evidence of incentive compatibility, fairness, Sybil resistance, selfish-mining resistance, coalition resistance, common-prefix security, chain-quality security or Bitcoin/PoW-equivalent security.  Stage 5 models bounded behaviours and measures outcomes; it does not prove PoCol defeats them.
